mapper.sql:
SELECT e.id, e.uuid, e.code, e.name, e.last_name, e.mother_last_name, e.birth_date, e.phone, e.email, e.address, e.contract_date, e.contract_end_date, e.active,
e.branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, e.job_scheduler_id, js.name AS job_scheduler_name, e.commune_id, cm.name AS commune_name, e.nationality_id, co.name AS country_name, co.nationality AS country_nationality, e.gender_id, g.name AS gender_name, e.marital_status_id, ms.name AS marital_status_name, e.contract_type_id, ct.name AS contract_type_name, e.job_type_id, jt.name AS job_type_name FROM employee e INNER JOIN branch b ON b.id = e.branch_id INNER JOIN job_scheduler js ON js.id = e.job_scheduler_id INNER JOIN commune cm ON cm.id = e.commune_id INNER JOIN country co ON co.id = e.nationality_id INNER JOIN gender g ON g.id = e.gender_id INNER JOIN marital_status ms ON ms.id = e.marital_status_id LEFT JOIN contract_type ct ON ct.id = e.contract_type_id INNER JOIN job_type jt ON jt.id = e.job_type_id
mapper.select: WHERE e.branch_id = #{branchId} ORDER BY e.last_name, e.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( uuid, branch_id, job_scheduler_id, commune_id, nationality_id, gender_id, marital_status_id, contract_type_id, job_type_id, code, name, last_name, mother_last_name, birth_date, phone, email, address, contract_date, contract_end_date, active ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{branch.id}, #{jobScheduler.id}, #{commune.id}, #{country.id}, #{gender.id}, #{maritalStatus.id}, #{contractType.id, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{jobType.id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{lastName}, #{motherLastName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address}, #{contractDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{contractEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET uuid = #{uuid}, branch_id = #{branch.id}, job_scheduler_id = #{jobScheduler.id}, commune_id = #{commune.id}, nationality_id = #{country.id}, gender_id = #{gender.id}, marital_status_id = #{maritalStatus.id}, contract_type_id = #{contractType.id, jdbcType=INTEGER}, job_type_id = #{jobType.id}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, last_name = #{lastName}, mother_last_name = #{motherLastName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, birth_date = #{birthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, phone = #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, email = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address = #{address}, contract_date = #{contractDate, jdbcType=DATE}, contract_end_date = #{contractEndDate, jdbcType=DATE}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
